description: This file defines the SubPanelTilesTabs class, a subclass responsible for managing tabbed subpanel layouts within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM framework. It includes methods for retrieving, customizing, and displaying subpanel groups as tabs, handling user preferences, and organizing subpanel modules for display on a detail view.

classes.name: SubPanelTilesTabs
classes.description: A class for managing tabbed layouts of subpanels in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM interface, allowing organization, customization, and display of subpanel groups as tabs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SubPanelTilesTabs object with focus and layout parameters.

methods.name: getSubpanelGroupLayout
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subpanel group layout preference for the current user.

methods.name: applyUserCustomLayoutToTabs
methods.description: Applies custom tab order preference for a user to a list of tab identifiers.

methods.name: getTabs
methods.description: Public method to generate tab views, delegating to an internal implementation.

methods.name: _getTabs
methods.description: Internal method that organizes subpanel IDs into tab groups, handles localization, and renders the tab navigation UI.
